title: Psychedelic One-Eyed Man
description: A surreal full-body portrait of a smiling bearded man with one large central eye, wearing a cracked colorful egg for a hat with a small red planet on top. He stands in a vibrant purple flower field holding a briefcase, dressed in a patterned suit, with a crystal ball containing miniature figures to his right and abstract line drawings floating above.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic illustration of a smiling bearded man with a single large central eye on his face, wearing a cracked colorful egg as a hat with a small red planet on top.
